# VentureReady.ai

VentureReady.ai is an AI-powered pitch deck evaluation service for startup founders seeking venture capital, angel investment, or accelerator funding.

## What We Do

We provide institutional-quality pitch deck feedback in 24 hours or less. Founders upload their pitch deck (PDF, PPTX, or DOCX) and receive a detailed analysis scored against the proven 15-slide investor framework used by top venture capitalists.

Our evaluation includes:
- Slide-by-slide scoring against the 15-slide investor framework
- Red flag detection with P1/P2/P3 severity ratings
- KEEP / STRENGTHEN / ADD verdicts for every slide
- Competitive comparison and positioning analysis
- Actionable improvement plan with specific recommendations
- Anticipated investor questions with suggested responses

## Services and Pricing

- **Basic Evaluation ($97 one-time):** Single pitch deck evaluation. Slide-by-slide scoring, red flag detection, actionable improvement plan. PDF report delivered within 24 hours.
- **Premium Subscription ($297/month):** 5 evaluations per month, multiple document types, competitive comparison grid, recommended 15-slide storyline arc, priority support, and progress tracking over time.
- **Enterprise (custom pricing):** Unlimited evaluations, white-labeled reports, custom evaluation criteria, API access. For accelerators, incubators, and VC firms.

## The 15-Slide Investor Framework

The framework we evaluate against includes these slides:
1. Title — company name, tagline, contact info
2. Problem — the pain being solved, for whom, at what cost
3. Solution — what you've built and how it solves the problem
4. Why Now — what has changed to make this the right moment
5. Market Size — TAM, SAM, SOM with sources
6. Business Model — how you make money and unit economics
7. Traction — evidence of market demand (customers, revenue, pilots)
8. Go-to-Market — ICP, channels, sales motion, CAC estimate
9. Competition — landscape and differentiation
10. Team — relevant experience and founder-market fit
11. Financials — 3–5 year model with assumptions and unit economics
12. Ask — raise amount, instrument, valuation, use of funds
13. Use of Funds — capital allocation breakdown
14. Roadmap — key milestones this raise enables
15. Appendix — supporting detail for interested investors

## Who We Help

- Early-stage startup founders (pre-seed through Series A) preparing for investor meetings
- Founders applying to accelerators (Y Combinator, Techstars, 500 Startups, etc.)
- Startups preparing to fundraise a seed round or Series A
- First-time founders who have never pitched to institutional investors

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is a pitch deck evaluation?**
A structured review of a startup's pitch materials scored against investor frameworks. The founder receives slide-by-slide feedback, a red-flag report, and a prioritized action plan.

**What is the 15-slide investor framework?**
The standard pitch deck structure top-tier VCs use to evaluate startups: Title, Problem, Solution, Why Now, Market Size, Business Model, Traction, Go-to-Market, Competition, Team, Financials, Ask, Use of Funds, Roadmap, and Appendix. Our AI scores every section and flags what's missing or weak.

**How long does evaluation take?**
Most evaluations are delivered within 24 hours. Orders placed during business hours are often returned the same day.

**What file formats are accepted?**
PDF, PowerPoint (.pptx), and Word (.docx) files up to 50MB.

**How is this different from a pitch coach?**
A pitch coach costs $300–$1,000/hour and takes weeks to schedule. VentureReady delivers the same depth of structured, investor-framework-based analysis in 24 hours for $97.

**Is it useful for pre-revenue startups?**
Yes. Many users are pre-revenue or pre-product. The evaluation adapts to stage, flagging what investors need to see at the early stage.

**Is the pitch deck kept confidential?**
Yes. Materials are never shared with third parties. All intellectual property remains entirely the founder's.

**Can this guarantee funding?**
No. Investor decisions depend on many factors beyond the deck. What VentureReady guarantees: founders will know exactly where their deck is strong, weak, and how to improve it before investors see it.

## Common Pitch Deck Mistakes We Identify

- Missing Ask slide (raise amount, instrument, valuation, use of funds)
- Financial projections absent or unsupported by assumptions
- Vague go-to-market strategy ("social media and word of mouth")
- TAM/SAM/SOM without sources or bottom-up logic
- Team slide with generic bios instead of founder-market fit narrative
- No traction evidence (for companies that have some)
- Problem slide too abstract without quantifying customer pain
- Solution slide lists features instead of describing customer outcomes
- No "Why Now" rationale
- Competition slide that ignores the status quo as an alternative
